title: Finding register file: security
description: One register file docs/findings/register/security/<ID>.json holds a minor security finding. The contract is interface-contracts.md, register file. The schema uses no oneOf, because schema-validate supports none, so finding-lint checks the rules that tie waived to the override keys.

id.description: The ID that next-id printed. The file name is <id>.json.

source.description: The review or session that found the finding.

review_class.description: The class of the register folder.

type.description: A type from the vocabulary of the class.

story.description: The story ID the review ran for, or null when no story exists yet.

finding.description: What is wrong and the fix, as plain text.

effect.description: What the attacker gains. The effect class sets the starting level.

second_breach.description: true when the attack needs another compromise first.

trusted_access.description: true when the attack needs a local shell, write access to the repository, or an account in the project.

non_default.description: true when the attack needs a configuration or an opt-in feature that the Factory does not enable by default.

user_action.description: true when the attack needs the user to do something unusual.

confidence.description: proven when the attack path is reproduced or traced from the input to the sink in the code; plausible otherwise.

in_use.description: true when the vulnerable code is in use. finding-lint checks it against git.

basis.description: The basis of the security class, as docs/spec/schemas/finding-basis.json defines it.

commit.description: The reviewed commit as 40 hexadecimal characters.

override_by.description: Human field. The stakeholder who lowered or waived the finding.

override_reason.description: Human field. Why the stakeholder lowered or waived the finding.
